notes.title: Hellcraze V4 is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Hellcraze has just another good update!

Shield bar color has been changed to be easier to see!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898791/4196b0ca0749e456db78483cfb847bffb8aab143.gif[/img]

You can now trade items for souls, you just got to drop them near the fireplaces on the levels area!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898791/2cc72340b6771de54ed1e6e325e5bdfa9ef0a1f1.gif[/img]

Changing guns now change the sprites of the player!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898791/bc217576741a1d8c5f854552cf605ae70579f5f0.gif[/img]

Other things also changed or fixed:
[list]
[*]You cannot loot anymore with inventory open (Controller only!)
[*]Fixed Dozomur dead animation
[*]Fixed Dozomur attack pattern
[/list]

Have fun playing!
Thank You!

notes.title: Hellcraze V3 is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Hellcraze has just got a big QoL update and some cool new features!

Some upgrades on the UI and Inventory!
[list]
[*] Now there is a better UI showing the gear Durability!
[*] Added inventory Drag and Drop!
[*] Right Clicking the item changes your equipment!
[*] Items are dropped and not broken anymore!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898791/78c3c0d135c033679a34f06f8f4227bf6763e543.png[/img]

Some changes on the Options Menu!
[list]
[*] Added a more extensive Options!
[*] You can now change your Key Inputs!
[*] You can active or inactive some parts of the UI!  
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898791/f19c32f1131384d6a54b284a417861ab5d2c3d5e.png[/img]

New Features!
[list]
[*] Added a minimap!
[*] Minimap shows you nearby enemies and items!
[*] Minimap will help on finding skulls!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898791/f6889fc80fe60b3d9b1fd313acbaf675c9c84b37.png[/img]

There was some minor bugs fixed as well, now the Aim Reticle shouldn't disappear anymore!

Have fun playing!
Thank You!

notes.title: Hellcraze V2 is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Hellcraze has just got a massive update, some bug fixes and some things were changed!

The UI has been changed, now the item options are shown as icons, it was added to the right corner a list of what the options are and what they do!
[list]
[*] Now items drop with up to +5 souls bonus per item!
[*] Every weapon have 1-5 damage level bonus and speed!
[*] Added to left corner of the screen the durability of the items!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898791/4627f7ea39b2a936507277bbcbbcac6a7252402a.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Now the game is more dark, the deeper the level you are the darker the game will get
[*] Bosses have their glowing light!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898791/05f32533e29a01ba0a2d3fd12196cab966dcd87e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Demons don't have glowing lights so be careful!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898791/e113eb63b201733c43ceefdab4e61f5c310a5a75.png[/img]

Have fun playing!
Thank You!

notes.title: Update - New features added!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Some new features were added to the game for a better QOL![/h1][/b]

[olist][h2]
[*] Added Gun name on top of the UI
[*] Changed inventory background gun icons
[*] Recolored the Icon of the Phaser
[*] Red doors now shows a hint
[*] Added signs (+) (=) (-) to compare guns
[*] Entering the Level area now recover all you HP/SH and bullets
[*] Removed that you lose Skulls when you die on a level that you had finished already[/h2]
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898791/49810d441d6e28f701ca922f6a7a9a3de206f4fd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898791/99f191b0fc496000da10f2da3220a1628ccaae2a.png[/img]

[h2]Thank you!
Have fun![/h2]
